info.title: CloudPDF Engine API
info.description: The backend-callable surface of the CloudPDF document engine: deployment and tenant administration plus the document operations (reads, annotations, forms, page operations, redaction, download). Interactive viewing goes through the CloudPDF viewer SDKs, whose session protocol is deliberately not part of this API. Generated from the @cloudpdf/contract operation registry — do not edit by hand.

post.summary: Trade a public share token for a short-lived document session JWT.
post.description: Unauthenticated, but requires a browser Origin header, checked against the grant allowlist. Unknown, revoked, and disabled tokens are indistinguishable (404). Passphrase-protected grants return 422 SharePasswordRequired until `password` is supplied. Mounted only when the deployment can sign (HS256 mode).

post.summary: Create a tenant, or confirm it already exists — ensure-style, idempotent.

delete.summary: Delete a tenant and everything under it.
delete.description: Destroys the tenant and everything in its namespace — documents, layers, stored bytes, audit history. Irreversible.

get.summary: List documents in the tenant, newest first, cursor-paginated.

delete.summary: Delete a document and its stored artifacts.

post.summary: Finish an upload: verify the SHA-256 and promote the document to ready.

get.summary: Download the stored base PDF bytes.
Fetch the warmed dashboard-tile render for a document.

post.summary: Upload a bounded PDF through the API when the initialized transfer kind is proxy.
post.description: This bounded origin-mediated fallback must only be used after documents.init returns upload.kind=proxy. Auto mode prefers a presigned object-store PUT whenever available.

post.summary: Begin an upload: create (or resume/dedupe) a pending document and issue upload access.
Lift a suspension; credentials for the tenant verify again.
Create a standing share grant for one document — the no-backend embed credential.
post.description: The returned share id IS the public share token. Mounted only when the deployment can sign (HS256 mode) — exchange mints session JWTs, so grants exist only where minting does.

get.summary: List share grants in the tenant, newest first, cursor-paginated.

patch.summary: Edit a grant in place — every embedded copy of the token follows the row.

delete.summary: Delete a grant; exchange stops immediately, live sessions lapse at their exp.

post.summary: Fail the tenant closed: refuse every tenant JWT, doc JWT, and share exchange.
post.description: Instantly reversible with resume. The API token is exempt, so a suspended tenant can still be inspected, exported, resumed, or deleted.

post.summary: Mint a delegated JWT: a doc token, or (API token only) a tenant token.
post.description: kind "tenant" requires the API token — authority mints only downward. Mounted only when the deployment can sign (HS256 mode); asymmetric deployments mint with their own private key.

post.summary: Revoke a token by jti; live sessions drop on their next heartbeat.
post.description: Mounted only when the deployment enables token revocation.

get.summary: Per-tenant usage facts (views, uploads, stored bytes) for one UTC month.
get.description: Facts only — no limits or billing state. Views count share exchanges plus authorized /v1/access grants, deduplicated across the two.

apiToken.description: The deployment's static root credential (CLOUDPDF_API_AUTH_TOKENS), valid on every surface.

tenantToken.description: Delegated tenant JWT, valid only under its own /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/ subtree — the path tenant must equal the token's tenant_id. Doc-scoped viewer tokens are rejected on every admin route.

docToken.description: Doc-scoped JWT, valid only on the /v1/docs/{docId} subtree it names, gated by the capability scopes it carries (each operation's x-required-capability).
